req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first s items and returns at most l items. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 20 rows (ids 1-20). Tests cover: (1) EP positive — typical skip+limit returning a deterministic slice; (2) EP positive — skip+limit together isolating a known middle window; (3) BVA boundary — limit=1 (minimum allowed by ge=1 constraint); (4) BVA boundary — skip equal to total row count returns empty list; (5) BVA boundary — limit at maximum allowed value (1000); (6) NEG — skip=-1 triggers 422; (7) NEG — limit=0 triggers 422 (violates ge=1); (8) DT — skip=0,limit=20 returns all 20 rows exactly; (9) BVA — skip=19 returns exactly 1 row (last row, id=20). Each test asserts exact status codes, exact list lengths, and exact id values to kill off-by-one, operator-flip, and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_pagination_typical_skip_and_limit
actions: Inspect response status code and body
expected: Response body is a list of exactly 3 tasks
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_pagination_typical_skip_and_limit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=3")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 3
    assert data[0]["id"] == 3
    assert data[1]["id"] == 4
    assert data[2]["id"] == 5
